synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO published a PDPASA Forecast Lack Of Reserve Level 1 (LOR1) for South Australia that included an early‑evening period on 29 July 2026; that forecast was cancelled before the day.

document_statements.quote: PDPASA - Forecast Lack Of Reserve Level 1 (LOR1) in the SA Region on 29/07/2026.
The forecast capacity reserve requirement is 400 MW.
The minimum capacity reserve available is 379 MW.
The Forecast LOR1 condition in the SA region advised in AEMO Electricity Market Notice No. 144652 is cancelled at 1345 hrs 28/07/2026.
